messages:
incident-bot: Pager: spike in external function/tool invocations causing backend 5xxs across hosted nodes — error rate 18% over 5m, latency SLOs breached. Paging @eng-oncall :rotating_light:

sam_k: got it, i'm oncall. quick check — is this only hosted region-us-east?

maria_g: seeing same in us-east + eu-west, but us-east is primary. lots of high-fanout agent requests hitting action-exec path.

tom_lee: suspected culprit: a customer loop that spawned high-rate tool calls. logs show many recurring request IDs from tenant=acme-internal.

eng-oncall: can we throttle or disable external action execution while we triage? prefer soft degrade to full outage.

maria_g: preparing a live mitigation — plan: 1) apply global rate cap on action exec surface for hosted tiers 2) block structured output->actions for free tier 3) route fallback to text-only generation for degraded requests. will notify CS.

sam_k: +1. please include a short sample command so infra can audit the change.

maria_g: running:

```bash
# apply global soft-rate for action exec (0.2 rps per tenant)
redwoodctl policies set --name "action-exec-softcap" --scope hosted --matcher "feature:action_exec" --rate 0.2/s --burst 5 --reason "mitigate runaway agent spikes"

# disable structured action payloads on free plan
redwoodctl flags set --flag disable_structured_actions --value true --scope plan:free --reason "emergency mitigation"
```

infra-bot: policy apply started: action-exec-softcap -> 5 nodes. job id 46f2c.

maria_g: also setting a short lived fallback at the proxy layer so any request that matches action_exec and exceeds rate -> downgrade to text-only mode. snippet:

```json
{"if": {"feature":"action_exec", "rate":{"gt":"0.2/s"}}, "then": {"rewrite":"response_mode:text_only","log":"mitigation:action-softcap-333777"}}
```

sam_k: great. CS, can you prepare customer comms for tenants impacted (esp ACME)? we should offer rollbacks for customers behind this who need pre-approved execs.

customer-success: on it — drafting notice. we'll prioritize ACME and any first-party integrations. asking: will this affect dedicated customers?

maria_g: dedicated clusters unaffected by hosted global rules. rule scope=hosted only. confirming now.

tom_lee: alerting model-serving teams to watch cache churn — we're seeing small CPU uptick due to fallback text-only code paths.

infra-bot: policy apply complete: job 46f2c success on 5/5 nodes. enforcement active.

eng-oncall: visible drop in 5xx rate to 3% within 30s. latency trending back toward SLO. thanks.

sam_k: continuing handoff to @maria_g for triage. i'll stay reachable for customer questions.

maria_g: will run targeted tenant traces and start safe-mode replay for ACME to find root cause. keeping this thread updated. :white_check_mark:

customer-success: heads-up sent to ACME support contact, included rollback option and ETA for next update (30m).

eng-oncall: if mitigation holds for 20m, we can transition to postmortem. for now keep escalation channel open.
